# FabricOps Starter Kit

> FabricOps Starter Kit helps teams build governed, quality-checked, AI-ready notebooks in Microsoft Fabric with reusable helpers, notebook templates, metadata-backed contracts, data quality checks, lineage, and handover evidence.

Use this file as a concise navigation map for LLMs, coding agents, and documentation ingestion workflows. The human-readable documentation is also published with Markdown variants where possible; for example, `/quick-start/` is available as `/quick-start.md`.

## Quick start

- [Quick Start](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/quick-start.md): First path through the starter workflow and key concepts.
- [Install](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/install.md): Package installation options and runtime setup notes.
- [Create Wheel](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/setup/create-wheel.md): Build a wheel for Microsoft Fabric upload.
- [Run in Fabric](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/setup/run-in-fabric.md): Configure a Fabric workspace, lakehouse targets, and notebook environment.

## Architecture

- [How FabricOps Works](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works.md): Overview of the governed Fabric notebook operating model.
- [Metadata Tables](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works/metadata-tables.md): Metadata table responsibilities and governance evidence model.
- [Pipeline Guardrails](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works/pipeline-guardrails.md): Runtime guardrails for schemas, freshness, DQ enforcement, and load behavior.
- [Metadata Dashboard](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works/metadata-dashboard.md): Operational visibility over metadata and governance outputs.

## Notebook flow

- [Notebook Templates](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works/notebook-templates.md): Responsibilities of `00_env_config`, agreement, pipeline, governance, and exploration notebooks.
- [Template Function Map](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference/template-function-map.md): Map from notebook templates to supported package helpers.

## Metadata and contracts

- [Data Quality and Governance](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/how-fabricops-works/governance-review.md): Review flows for column context, classification, DQ rules, and governance evidence.
- [DQ Rules Reference](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference/dq-rules.md): Supported rule types, parameters, examples, and enforcement expectations.
- [Glossary](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference/glossary.md): Shared terminology for governed notebook delivery.

## API reference

- [Function Reference](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference.md): Public callable reference generated from source docstrings and metadata.
- [Functions by Module](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/api/modules.md): Module-oriented callable index for package users and maintainers.
- [Agent Manifest](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference/agent-manifest.json): Machine-readable helper metadata for AI coding agents.
- [Function Manifest](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/reference/function-manifest.json): Machine-readable function inventory and dependency metadata.

## Handover and maintenance

- [Release Management](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/development/release-management.md): Maintainer workflow for releases, versioning, and generated references.
- [Documentation Versioning](https://voycepeh.github.io/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/development/docs-versioning.md): Documentation versioning and traceability guidance.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution workflow and expectations.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md): Repository-level overview and navigation.

## Reference proposal

- [llms.txt proposal](https://llmstxt.org/): Reference proposal for publishing a concise Markdown navigation map and Markdown page variants for LLM access.
